biography: Professor Lindelani E. Mnguni is a prominent South African academic, education activist, and the Dean of the Faculty of Education at the University of Pretoria (UP), a role he assumed on 1 January 2025. He specializes in Science Education and Curriculum and Instructional Design and Development. His research focuses on integrating 21st-century technologies, such as artificial intelligence (AI), computer simulations, and visual models, to enhance Life Sciences and STEM education.
